title: The obliteration room
description: Visitors transform a white domestic interior by adding colourful dot stickers. Everyday furniture gradually disappears beneath a shared field of colour.
detail: Created in collaboration with Queensland Art Gallery, this participatory installation makes each visitor part of its changing appearance. Notice how repeated dots connect separate objects and change your sense of the room.
source: QAGOMA Collection · 2012.098 · Demo placement; current display not confirmed
imageCredit: © Yayoi Kusama. Courtesy: Yayoi Kusama Studio, Inc. Image: QAGOMA.
chineseIntroduction: 《消融的房间》，草间弥生，2002年至今。观众将彩色圆点贴纸贴在白色家具和空间表面，让熟悉的房间逐渐变成共同创作的色彩世界。作品与昆士兰美术馆合作完成。观察圆点如何连接不同物体，又如何改变你对空间的感受。

title: In bed
description: A woman lies in bed, absorbed in thought. Ron Mueck combines a familiar, private moment with an unexpectedly large scale, inviting a slower look at posture and expression.
detail: The mixed-media sculpture was made in 2005 and acquired by QAGOMA in 2008. Its large quilt and carefully constructed figure turn an ordinary scene into an encounter with vulnerability and introspection.
source: QAGOMA Collection · 2008.040 · Demo placement; current display not confirmed
imageCredit: © Ron Mueck. Photograph: J Ruckli © QAGOMA.
chineseIntroduction: 《床上》，Ron Mueck，2005年，综合材料雕塑。一位女子躺在床上，仿佛沉浸在自己的思绪中。作品以超出日常经验的尺度呈现身体和被褥，使一个私密片刻变得格外引人注目。请留意她的姿势与表情，想一想尺度如何影响你的观看感受。

title: Heritage
medium: 99 life-sized animal replicas: polystyrene, gauze, resin and hide
description: Life-sized animal replicas gather around a still waterhole. Inspired by Queensland landscapes, Cai Guo-Qiang imagines a meeting place where different species share one essential resource.
detail: The complete work comprises 99 animals and was commissioned for QAGOMA in 2013. Its imagined gathering invites reflection on coexistence and our relationship with the natural world. The installation photograph records a past presentation.
source: QAGOMA Collection · 2013.190.001-099 · Demo placement; current display not confirmed
imageCredit: © Cai Guo-Qiang. Photograph: Natasha Harth © QAGOMA.
chineseIntroduction: 《遗产》，蔡国强，2013年。不同物种的等身动物模型围绕水池聚集，仿佛在共享同一片水源。完整作品由99只动物模型组成，灵感来自昆士兰的自然景观。这个宁静而不寻常的场景，邀请我们思考共存、资源与人与自然的关系。

title: Soul under the moon
medium: Mirrors, ultraviolet lights, water, plastic, nylon thread, timber and synthetic polymer paint
description: Suspended fluorescent spheres multiply in mirrored reflections. A room with physical boundaries seems to open into an endless field of light and colour.
detail: Kusama conceived this installation for the 2002 Asia Pacific Triennial. Mirrors and ultraviolet light turn repeated forms into an immersive experience. Consider how a small change in viewpoint might shift the apparent depth of the space.
source: QAGOMA Collection · 2002.143a-y · Demo placement; current display not confirmed
imageCredit: © Yayoi Kusama. Courtesy: Yayoi Kusama Studio, Inc. Image: QAGOMA.
chineseIntroduction: 《月下之魂》，草间弥生，2002年。悬挂的荧光球体在镜面中不断重复，灯光与倒影让有限的房间看起来仿佛没有尽头。作品为2002年亚太当代艺术三年展构思。试着想象，当你的视角移动时，这片光与色彩的空间会怎样改变。
